resources.string: Not a driver package (.zip or .so): the driver wasn\'t changed.

The graphics driver couldn\'t run the game. On the Galaxy Tab S10 Ultra (a Mali GPU) only the system driver works: with a custom driver installed, tap Use the system driver; otherwise install the tablet\'s latest software update. On Adreno GPUs, a Turnip driver for your GPU (.zip) usually solves it: tap Install a driver.\n\nDetails:
